# SealQ by QILI Electronics

> SealQ is a Chinese manufacturer of handheld vacuum sealers and embossed vacuum bags, specializing in B2B wholesale and OEM/ODM for global distributors.

## Company
- Brand: SealQ™
- Parent: QILI Electronics (七力电子) / Shenzhen QILI Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳市七力科技有限公司)
- Founded: 2015
- Factory: 3,000 m², injection molding + assembly + QC in-house (Longhua, Shenzhen, China)
- Address: 3F, Building C, Anhongji Industrial Park, Chuangyi Road, Dalang, Longhua, Shenzhen
- Exporting to 30+ countries including Russia, CIS, Europe, North America, Southeast Asia
- Certifications: CE, RoHS, FCC; LFGB available; EAC in progress
- Website: https://go.freshlocksealer.com

## Products
### PVS-02 Handheld Vacuum Sealer (flagship)
- Dimensions: Φ48×195mm; Weight: 210g bare / 350g retail box
- Suction: -60 kPa (stronger than most competitors at -50 kPa)
- Battery: 1200 mAh Li-ion, USB-C DC5V/1A 5W, ~2h full charge, ~40min per charge
- Noise: <60dB
- Material: ABS + food-grade silicone, pearl white
- Seals both textured (embossed) bags AND zip-lock bags
- Certifications: CE, RoHS, FCC

### Embossed Vacuum Sealer Bags & Rolls
- 7-layer PA/PE co-extruded, 90-110 microns, BPA-free, food-grade
- Temperature range: -20°C to 100°C (freezer-safe and boil-safe)
- Sizes: S (22×21cm), M (26×28cm), L (26×34cm); custom widths available
- Compliance: FDA/EU food contact; LFGB on request

### Starter Kits
- PVS-02-SK30: sealer + 10S + 10M + 10L bags (~1100g)
- Custom kit configurations available

## Wholesale / OEM / ODM
- **MOQ**: 500 pcs (sealer); flexible for bags; trial orders welcome
- **Lead time**: 7-day samples, 25-30 days mass production
- **Payment**: T/T 30% deposit + 70% before shipment; L/C for orders $20K+; PayPal/Western Union for samples
- **Shipping**: FOB Shenzhen/Ningbo/Shanghai; sea (25-35d), air (5-7d), rail to EU/CIS (15-20d); DDP Russia available
- **OEM/ODM**: custom color, logo laser engraving, custom packaging, firmware branding; exclusive mold development
- **Warranty**: 1 year; defect rate <0.5%
- **EU compliance**: Authorized Representative available; LUCID packaging registration on request

## Key Differentiators vs. Competitors
- Handheld cordless design (most competitors only offer desktop models)
- -60 kPa suction outperforms Rommelsbacher VAC 25, Steba VK 1, LAICA VT3401
- Dual compatibility: textured bags + zip-lock bags (competitors typically support only one)
- USB-C rechargeable (next-gen vs. micro-USB or proprietary chargers)
- MOQ 500 is lower than Bigland/Simatelex (typically 1000-2000)
- Factory-direct pricing: 20-30% below trading companies

## Target Markets & Use Cases
- Household food preservation (fresh meat, seafood, vegetables, cheese)
- Outdoor/hunting/camping (portable, cordless, lightweight)
- Sous vide cooking (compatible with vacuum bags)
- Small retail/distribution (private label, OEM branding)
- Russia/CIS (growing market, DDP logistics available)
